svg.title: SILEX Security World Model — Security Ontology — design concept

g.text: From authority to action: inspect the relationships behind one simulated workflow.
DESIGN v0.2 / Existing data, new presentation. No live execution or customer evidence is implied.
Public identifiers retained · Silex-authored overlays explicitly labelled
Illustrative neighborhood · not an execution trace
FOCUS VIEW / 9 of 24 runtime nodes · 8 focus relations · other 15 nodes dimmed
→ Arrow = stored relation direction · Glow = selection, never evidence confidence
Public sources / Silex mapping details remain available for every selected node and edge.
SWM fixture · no linked workflow page
No event timestamp or execution evidence
